# Ashish Nagmoti

> AI Engineer and Backend Developer from Maharashtra, India. AI & Data Science student at K.K. Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research (9.1 CGPA, graduating 2026). Builds backend systems, AI integrations and cloud infrastructure with Python, Django, FastAPI, AWS and GCP. Open to work — remote or onsite.

This site (https://ashish-nagmoti.tech) is a portfolio styled as a macOS desktop. The content below is the same information the visual site presents, in plain text for agents. It is hand-maintained; when it and a linked source disagree, trust the source.

## Projects

- [System Map – Isometric Codebase Visualizer](https://github.com/ashish-nagmoti/codebase-isometric-visualizer): A Claude Code skill that reads a codebase and renders its real routes, functions, models and tables as an interactive isometric blueprint diagram. Every number is pulled from source, never invented. Outputs a single self-contained HTML file. Aug 2026. Tech: Claude Code, HTML, SVG, JavaScript.
- [StoryMail – AI-Powered Smart Email Platform](https://github.com/ashish-nagmoti/storymail): Classifies emails, generates weekly digests, and lets users query their inbox in natural language. Mar–Oct 2024. Tech: Django, Auth0, PostgreSQL, Gemini API. Live: http://story-mail-olive.vercel.app/
- [KalaShala – Platform Empowering Local Artists](https://github.com/ashish-nagmoti/kalashala-backend): A platform for local artists to showcase work, publish content and grow an audience. Role: backend development and deployment. Feb–Mar 2024. Tech: Django, AWS, PostgreSQL. Live: https://kalashala-frontend1-zxra.vercel.app/
- [AceUp – Student Resource Hub with AI Chatbot](https://github.com/riaan-attar/AceUp): Notes, roadmaps, events and an integrated AI chatbot for students. 2024. Tech: Django, Tailwind CSS, Jinja, SQLite3, Python. Live: https://inevitable-lucky-predeator-b19e8de5.koyeb.app/
